checks.detail: All 60 numerical data rows in the six v14 numerical result tables occur verbatim in v15 supplementary Tables S1-S6. Six study-design rows were rewritten without changing counts or information conditions.
Independent JSON-pointer, arithmetic-mean and min/max comparisons passed for 396 seed values and 132 means across 21 panels. Four input hashes and all 12 redrawn output-file hashes match.
Row-major endpoints: Q1_age10, K02-HDL-BMI, Q2_bmi5, K02-TC-BMI, Q3_bmi5, K02-LIPID-RESIDUAL; HbA1c left a/c/e and lipids right b/d/f match caption, renderer and inspected image.

24 laws, 72 distinct final tables and 216 coefficients; five of six Agent mean-discrepancy contrasts improve, CHNS BMI worsens. Statistical E1 laws beat all corresponding Agent laws for CHNS glucose and ENSANUT glucose-adjusted BMI, as disclosed.

6 laws, 18 final tables, 24 physical attempts, 54 primary values with 54 matching point signs; 513 outputs, 324 matched references and 189 generated-only. All 72 displayed values in Table S5 match frozen summaries at six-decimal precision.

CHNS CR1-t intervals, ENSANUT cluster-resampling stability bands, lipid HC3 assumption-conditional sensitivity intervals and fixed-law seed ranges remain distinct. TC interval crosses zero; residual-correlation and lipid-SD reference intervals are unavailable.
Six laws, 18 distinct delivery tables, 90 displayed statistics; initial/final revision deltas are all zero. 42 physical executions and 24 distinct tables including trials are preserved in supplement.

Q4 has 12 final tables, 36 matching-direction primary points and 366 final outputs. HRS aggregate coefficient is -0.04463527866460568 versus -0.046837; 11509 subjects x 4 visits, six valid tables and three invalid initial comparator attempts remain disclosed.
8 unique originals, 22 paper uses, 7 queries, 1 download, and all 132 runtime checks not computable. All six Q5 decisions retain initial laws; no source-fit or revision-gain claim.

Frozen sensitivity yields +0.03422166782944728 and -0.010945782275772408 at latent correlations 0.10 and 0.40 with unchanged secondary projection. Worked projection values agree with full-precision residual SDs in the source/assumptions supplement; 0.44 Spearman converts to 0.4567017402.

Developmental exposure, supplied summaries/source models, shared model services and sources, no quantitative cohort replacement, no calibrated design/power use, no causal interpretation, no component advantage and no first-priority claim are maintained.
All 12 reused figure files are byte-identical to v14 and match reuse hashes. All 32 local Markdown destinations resolve.

limitations: This checks consistency with frozen aggregate artifacts; it does not independently refit clinical or generated tables or validate source studies and population transport.
Figure PNGs were inspected for content mapping; final assembled-PDF layout and venue compliance require separate review.
